newsitem.title: FRANCE: BVA says yet to start opinion poll for Paris Match.
newsitem.headline: BVA says yet to start opinion poll for Paris Match.

text.p: An official at French polling organisation BVA said on Friday it would be conducting an opinion poll of voters' intentions for French weekly Paris Match but has yet to start polling.
Futures traders in Paris said talk of a poll by BVA for Paris Match said to show a slim majority for a combination of the Socialists and the Communists, was weighing on prices.
The official said BVA would start polling Friday evening and would not have any final results until Monday. She did not know when the results would be released by Paris Match.
